result.title: CausalNTP: A World-Model Recipe for Causal Next-Token Prediction under Noisy Training-data
result.summary: This paper shows that transformer networks trained with next-token prediction (NTP) and gradient descent do not learn to make predictions using only causally-relevant tokens in the left context, irrespective of the causal ordering of tokens during training, and identifies the learning deficiencies responsible. We introduce a causal world-model setup, for which, we characterize the Bayes-optimal predictor under the causal view of the data. We then prove that, a function that distills its predictions to non-causal views of data, when realized under Occam's Razor, recovers the true causal predictor. Based on this analysis we propose CausalNTP, a practical training algorithm that approximates this theoretical recipe and trains transformers to depend only the causally relevant tokens in left-context. Empirically in the world-model setup, CausalNTP achieves out-of-distribution generalization that vanilla NTP cannot due to its theoretical limits, regardless of data and model scale. We show similar gains and behavior in the natural language question-answering setting as a proof-of-concept.

AI.brief_summary: 论文指出 NTP 训练的 transformer 并不只依赖左文中的因果相关 token，给出因果世界模型的贝叶斯最优预测刻画，并提出把预测蒸馏到非因果数据视图的训练算法 CausalNTP，以逼近真实因果预测器并改善 OOD 泛化。
AI.relevance_reason: 「蒸馏到非因果视图、借 Occam 偏好只保留因果相关输入」这一训练监督思路，可能与 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、答案对 latent 内容的因果使用及贡献分配问题相关；但该文为纯文本设定、不涉及视觉 latent 状态，可供核查其可迁移性。
